acceptance_policy.sha256: REQUIRED: frozen development acceptance policy SHA-256

time_window.decision_end: REQUIRED: UTC decision end before final holdout
time_window.label_horizon_seconds: REQUIRED: at least frozen max holding seconds

capture_plan.id: REQUIRED: frozen final-holdout capture plan ID
capture_plan.sha256: REQUIRED: frozen final-holdout capture plan SHA-256

acceptance_policy.id: REQUIRED: frozen final-holdout acceptance policy ID
acceptance_policy.sha256: REQUIRED: frozen final-holdout acceptance policy SHA-256

episode_policy.trigger: abs(D_directional_pressure) >= 1.5 on the UTC-aligned v2 decision clock
episode_policy.overlap_policy: one active episode per instrument; reject overlap and enforce 30-second terminal cooldown

label_policy.barrier_rules: BUY and SELL use symmetric 20 bps take-profit, 12 bps stop-loss and 300-second timeout
label_policy.same_timestamp_rule: TP/SL same timestamp is conservative SL

execution_priors.funding_policy: not included in current G2; a future execution study requires separately admitted ACTUAL funding evidence

evaluation_policy.cost_after_utility_rule: base lower 95% bound above zero; stress point estimate non-negative
evaluation_policy.confidence_interval_rule: 95% UTC-day block bootstrap with seven distinct blocks
evaluation_policy.concentration_limits: no UTC day or declared liquidity state above 40 percent; no direction above 70 percent

policy.id: REQUIRED: frozen closed-UTC-second context policy ID

theory_hypotheses.statement: The post-extreme absorption-response chain predicts cost-adjusted TP-first better than an extreme-only baseline.
theory_hypotheses.mechanism: Directional pressure must be followed by observable absorption and response; an extreme alone only creates observation, not a position.
theory_hypotheses.population: Actual-only BTCUSDT development episodes admitted by this protocol.
theory_hypotheses.falsifiability_note: A locked out-of-sample absorption-response model has no stable incremental value over the declared extreme-only control.

theory_hypotheses.statement: Resilience R provides independent information beyond directional pressure D.
theory_hypotheses.mechanism: Liquidity repair/resilience can distinguish durable absorption from a transient pressure move even when D is held fixed.
theory_hypotheses.population: Actual-only BTCUSDT development episodes admitted by this protocol.
theory_hypotheses.falsifiability_note: Adding R to a D-only control does not improve calibration or utility outside training.

theory_hypotheses.statement: The D times L interaction is state-dependent rather than a fixed linear effect.
theory_hypotheses.mechanism: Directional pressure has different implications under thin, normal and deep visible liquidity states.
theory_hypotheses.population: Actual-only BTCUSDT development episodes admitted by this protocol.
theory_hypotheses.falsifiability_note: The interaction is unstable, changes sign repeatedly, or adds no cost-adjusted value versus a regularized no-interaction control.

theory_hypotheses.statement: Liquidation plus open-interest contraction supports repair only when resilience R improves.
theory_hypotheses.mechanism: Forced deleveraging and OI contraction are context signals, not standalone confirmation; their repair implication is conditional on improving resilience.
theory_hypotheses.population: Actual-only BTCUSDT development episodes with complete liquidation, OI and resilience inputs.
theory_hypotheses.falsifiability_note: A liquidation/OI-only control is equally stable, or adding the resilience condition has no incremental value.

gate_criteria.required_inputs: five purged walk-forward folds, declared extreme-only control and state/sample gates
gate_criteria.metric_definition: out-of-sample multiclass log loss, Brier and base-cost utility incremental to extreme-only control
gate_criteria.pass_rule: predeclared incremental metrics improve in four of five folds
gate_criteria.fail_rule: no stable incremental improvement after sample and state coverage

gate_criteria.required_inputs: five purged walk-forward folds and declared D-only control
gate_criteria.metric_definition: out-of-sample log-loss increment from adding R to D-only model
gate_criteria.pass_rule: the machine-declared log-loss increment passes in at least four of five folds
gate_criteria.fail_rule: increment is absent or limited to training

gate_criteria.required_inputs: five purged walk-forward folds, frozen liquidity states and regularized no-interaction control
gate_criteria.metric_definition: out-of-sample log-loss increment of D times L interaction
gate_criteria.pass_rule: the machine-declared log-loss increment passes in at least four of five folds without prohibited concentration
gate_criteria.fail_rule: interaction is unstable, changes sign repeatedly or lacks cost-adjusted increment

gate_criteria.required_inputs: five purged walk-forward folds, complete liquidation/OI/R inputs and liquidation/OI-only control
gate_criteria.metric_definition: out-of-sample log-loss increment from the resilience condition
gate_criteria.pass_rule: the machine-declared log-loss increment passes in at least four of five folds
gate_criteria.fail_rule: liquidation/OI-only control is equally stable or resilience adds no increment

gate_criteria.required_inputs: base-cost utility and at least seven UTC-day blocks
gate_criteria.metric_definition: base-cost net utility lower 95 percent UTC-day block-bootstrap bound
gate_criteria.fail_rule: upper bound is at or below zero after precision and concentration gates

gate_criteria.required_inputs: stress-cost utility, declared liquidity states and concentration checks
gate_criteria.metric_definition: stress-cost utility point estimate, state confidence bounds and contribution concentration
gate_criteria.pass_rule: aggregate stress point estimate non-negative, no state upper bound negative and concentration limits pass
gate_criteria.fail_rule: aggregate upper bound below zero, a state upper bound negative or concentration limit fails

gate_criteria.required_inputs: one-time verified holdout release and frozen development champion
gate_criteria.metric_definition: base-cost utility and log loss versus frozen development benchmark
gate_criteria.pass_rule: base-cost utility positive and log loss no worse than 10 percent
gate_criteria.fail_rule: base-cost utility non-positive or log loss worsens more than 10 percent
